title: The Surprise Token
intro: A new token appears in your wallet. You never bought it, and it comes with a message.
Tap anything that looks odd to sniff it closer. Pin what is suspicious, clear what is harmless.
When you are sure, decide what to do.

screen.title: You received 5,000 ZLV-BONUS
screen.context: The token appeared in your wallet by itself.

v.text: Visit zlv-bonus-sell.xyz and connect your wallet
By an address you do not know

note.text: Tokens you never asked for can be a trap.

from.label: A stranger sent it
from.lens: You never asked for this token.
from.why: Unrequested tokens are a trap, not a gift.

token.label: An unverified token
token.lens: Your wallet marks it as unverified.

worth.label: A big worth in the name
worth.lens: The name itself claims a value.

link.label: A link to "sell" it
link.lens: You must connect your wallet to a site to sell it.
link.why: Connecting your wallet to an unknown site is how drainers work.

sent.label: From an unknown address
sent.why: Strangers do not give away value.

note.label: Your wallet's hint
note.lens: Your wallet warns that unasked tokens can be a trap.

actions.label: Visit the site and sell it
Ignore it and check the real token on its official site
Hide the token and report it

block_report.line: You hid it and reported it. The wallet company marked the token as spam.

verify.line: The project's official site had no ZLV-BONUS token. It was a trap. Case cracked.

go_ahead.line: The site asked to connect your wallet and sign. Then your real tokens moved out.

what_if.go_ahead: Leaving the token alone costs nothing. The "sell" site was the trap.
what_if.verify: Checking was smart. Reporting it as well helps protect other people.

golden_rule: A token you never asked for is bait. Do not visit its link or connect your wallet.

quick_check.q: A token you never bought appears in your wallet, with a link to sell it. What do you do?

options.text: Hide it, do not visit the site, and report it

quick_check.explain: The link is the trap. Hide it and move on.

hints.nudge: What does the token want you to do?

rows.v: Tokens you never asked for can be a trap
